summary: Comprehensive technical implementation plan for upgrading the Tier 2 workflow in the frontend UI and backend integration. Implements explicit Tier 1/Tier 2/Tier 3 badges, dual-mode Tier 2 fuel property overrides with official citations (IANOR NA 8110, NA 11042, CREG Décret 21-64, Sonatrach ISO 6976, API Compendium 2021), live calculation impact preview, and inline custom factor quick-add modal.
